label: /i/
notes: Peterson & Barney 1952 adult-male mean, /i/ heed (#28 original)

label: /er/
notes: Peterson & Barney 1952, heard -- low F3 is the rhotic cue

label: /ax/
notes: neutral reduced schwa -- also reused as the closure/SIL cascade shape below

label: /ey/
notes: diphthong -- single static midpoint target; true glide is P3 sequencer work

label: /n/
notes: alveolar -- higher F2 locus than /m/ (#29 original)

label: /ng/
notes: velar -- highest cascade F2 locus of the three nasals in this model

label: /sh/
notes: same cascade as /s/; lower fric_F is the ear cue (#29 original)

label: /th/
notes: dental -- weakest, most diffuse voiceless fricative

label: /hh/
notes: glottal aspiration -- wide/diffuse fric_B, no sharp resonance

label: /l/
notes: alveolar lateral -- vowel-like cascade, no dedicated lateral branch here

label: /r/
notes: rhotic -- low F3, same cue as /er/

label: /p-cl/
notes: bilabial voiceless closure -- silent, cascade shape irrelevant

label: /b-cl/
notes: bilabial voiced closure -- conventionally shorter than voiceless

label: /p-br/
notes: bilabial voiceless release -- low, diffuse burst

label: /b-br/
notes: bilabial voiced release -- weak voicing continues into the burst

label: /t-br/
notes: alveolar voiceless release -- high, diffuse-rising burst

label: /k-br/
notes: velar voiceless release -- compact mid-frequency burst

label: /ch-br/
notes: alveopalatal voiceless release -- SH-like frication tail, longer than a plain stop burst

label: /jh-br/
notes: alveopalatal voiced release -- ZH-like frication tail

label: /sil/
notes: inter-word pause / rest -- silent, reuses the neutral cascade shape
